payload.name: The Half-Finished Watchers
payload.situation: In the detonated Steel Watch assembly halls beneath Wyrm's Rock, the party must reach the central control cradle while dormant war-constructs wake in waves as the arcane current is disturbed.
payload.objective: Reach and shut down the master cradle before all three husk-lines finish powering up.
combatants: 2 half-finished Steel Watchers (bruisers, wake in sequence)
an overseer-construct that buffs the line (controller)
payload.terrain: Vaulted hall with assembly-cradles (hard cover + verticality), pools of burnt forge-oil (a hazard the party can ignite), and a central catwalk.
payload.twist: Shutting the cradle early drops power to the husks mid-fight — a risk/reward lever: rush the objective and skip the fight, or clear the room first.
payload.stakes: If the overseer finishes the line, the constructs march on the refugee camp at the Basilisk Gate.
